$comment: CHANGE stories with the START unknown (Year pages R, 2026-11-14; 1.OA.A.1 / 2.OA.A.1 'add to / take from, start unknown', de 'Anfangsmenge gesucht', sv 'starten saknas'): the change ({n2}) and the end ({n3}) are told, what was there at the start is asked. Slots as in word-problems-levelset.json: {n2} {n3} {noun} {name} {name2}, {Q} = how many, agreeing (es, pt, it), {il} = il / elle of the name (fr). No frame puts a word for 'some' before the thing where that word would have to agree with it (es, pt: a bare plural; it, fi: the story begins with what is done). `place` frames tell the things in a place and suit any amount; `people` frames tell a child and are used within 20 only. A take-away story is told with somebody who takes. Read by a native reader (2026-11-14). Only the start-unknown story pages read this file.
